home.sosSubtitle: Alerts nearby ambulances and the community desk

web.heroTitle: Doctors, medicines, lab tests and a 24×7 SOS for every home
web.heroBody: {{brand}} brings home healthcare to gated communities, apartments, families, senior-living homes and employers.

console.title: {{brand}} console
console.signInPrompt: Staff sign in with email and two-factor authentication.
console.notStaff: This account has no console access. Ask a super admin to add a role.
console.mfaEnrollBody: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or similar), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
console.mfaVerifyBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
console.wrongCode: That code didn't work. Codes change every 30 seconds; try the current one.

auth.phoneTitle: Sign in with your mobile number
auth.whatsappNotice: We'll also send booking and service updates on WhatsApp. Reply STOP at any time to stop them.
auth.wrongCode: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
auth.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
auth.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {{seconds}} s
auth.useSms: Get the code by SMS instead
auth.fieldOnly: This app is for field staff. Ask your supervisor to add your number, then sign in again.
